review_candidates.title: System Administrator (Remote)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Role: System Administrator (Remote) Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere) Role Overview: We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a System Administrator to work on a Full-Time basis. Responsibilities include troubleshooting, maintenance, and security oversight for critical systems. Key Responsibilities: • Maintain and administer cloud-based infrastructure, including servers, networks, and storage systems. Required Skills & Qualifications: • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Required Skills & Qualifications: • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is required. • Proficiency in Linux/Unix system administration and command-line operations is essential. Equal Opportunity Employer: We hire based on skills and expertise. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.
